newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen may extend deadline for diplomat's release.
newsitem.headline: Yemen may extend deadline for diplomat's release.

text.p: Yemen said on Wednesday it might extend a midnight (2100 GMT) deadline for tribesmen to free a French diplomat abducted on Monday.
"If the deadline which we set ends and we need more time or a few hours until we settle the issue, we might extend it," Abdul-Wali al-Shumairi, governor of Marib province, told Reuters.
Shumairi said he met the French ambassador and agreed that "any negotiations with the abductors have to go through local authorities".
"The ambassador assured me that the embassy will not carry out any negotiations with the hostage takers".
Security sources said earlier the tribesmen had asked to talk to officials from the French embassy to embarrass the Yemeni government. The diplomat has not been named.
The tribesmen are demanding government compensation for damage caused by floods in June, more jobs and settlement of a land dispute.
